def test_carts_workflow():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    item_id = f"item_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    item_data = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": 9.99
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert any(i.get("itemId") == item_id for i in items)

    item_data["quantity"] = 5
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    fetched_item = resp.json()
    assert fetched_item.get("quantity") == 5

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_carts_merge():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    session_id = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    item_a = {"itemId": "item_a", "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 10.0}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json=item_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    item_b = {"itemId": "item_b", "quantity": 2, "unitPrice": 20.0}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    item_ids = [i.get("itemId") for i in items]
    assert "item_a" in item_ids
    assert "item_b" in item_ids

    }
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)

    addr_data = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
        "street": "Downing St",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_data, timeout=10)
    address_id = resp.json().get("id")

    card_data = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_data, timeout=10)
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    item_data = {
        "itemId": "item_1",
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": 15.0
    }
    requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)

    order_req = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{address_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order.get("id")
    assert order_id is not None

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    fetched_order = resp.json()
    assert fetched_order.get("id") == order_id
    assert fetched_order.get("customer", {}).get("username") == username

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer_orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o.get("id") == order_id for o in customer_orders)
